# ClawSkills
> The definitive directory for OpenClaw AI agent skills.

## About
ClawSkills is the most comprehensive resource for discovering, comparing, and installing OpenClaw skills. We catalog 5,705+ skills across 10 categories with curated reviews, security analysis, and one-click installation commands.

## Pages
- / — Homepage with featured skills, articles, and tutorials
- /skills — Browse 5,705+ OpenClaw skills across 10 categories with search and filtering
- /skills/ai-llms — AI & LLMs skills: prompt chaining, model routing, RAG pipelines, embeddings

## Key Features
- One-click install commands: `npx clawhub@latest install <skill-name>`
- Security status indicators: Verified, Community, Unreviewed
- Skill ratings and reviews
- Related skills and alternatives
- FAQ sections for every skill
- Compatibility information (macOS, Linux, Windows WSL)

## Content Types
- Skill Pages: Detailed reference pages with install commands, use cases, FAQs, compatibility, and alternatives
- Articles: Long-form "best of" lists reviewing 5-10 skills per category
- Tutorials: Step-by-step guides from beginner to advanced levels
